name: Vulcan Materials

logo.source: vulcanmaterials.com site header SVG (Vulcan_Logo_Blue.svg); Wikipedia PNG is only 112 px wide

description: Vulcan is the largest US producer of construction aggregates (crushed stone, sand and gravel), with about 10% of a fragmented US market. It owns 16.6 billion tons of reserves at 425 active facilities, and because stone is heavy and costly to haul, each quarry sells mostly within a local radius. It also makes asphalt mix and ready-mixed concrete, which mostly consume its own aggregates. Aggregates earned 90% of 2025 gross profit on 227 million tons shipped at a freight-adjusted price of $21.98 per ton, up 4%. Demand comes from public roads and infrastructure, which is steadier, and from private housing and commercial construction.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source in this pass. SEC SIC 1400 (Mining & Quarrying of Nonmetallic Minerals). Aggregates are 90% of gross profit, so this is mainly a quarry-and-reserves business; Vulcan reports only three segments (aggregates, asphalt, concrete).

employees.note: Computed from the 10-K: 11,172 US, 280 Mexico, 32 Honduras, 63 Canada, 1 Bahamas; 1,057 US employees union-represented

businessLines.name: Aggregates
businessLines.how: Sells stone by the ton at prices set in each local market; profit per ton is price minus cost, so a small price rise flows mostly to profit because quarry costs are largely fixed. Freight-adjusted price rose to $21.98 per ton freight-adjusted from $21.08 while the freight-adjusted cash cost per ton was $10.65.
businessLines.description: Crushed stone, sand, gravel and other aggregates from quarries, sold mostly to local contractors, public agencies and its own asphalt and concrete plants; delivered by truck, rail, barge or ship.

revenue.note: segment sales incl. $497.1M sold to its own segments

businessLines.revenueNote: segment sales incl. $497.1M sold to its own segments

businessLines.name: Asphalt
businessLines.how: Sells hot-mix asphalt by the ton to paving contractors and public agencies, mostly using Vulcan's own aggregates and liquid asphalt bought in; average price $81.93 per ton and gross profit $12.98 per ton FY2025.
businessLines.description: Asphalt mix (about 95% aggregates by weight), mostly in the West and Southwest.

businessLines.name: Concrete
businessLines.how: Sells concrete by the cubic yard to builders and contractors; gross profit was $8.05 per cubic yard in 2025 vs $3.60 in 2024. Thin margin, mostly a way to use its aggregates.
businessLines.description: Ready-mixed concrete made from cement, aggregates, admixtures and water.

brands.name: Vulcan Materials (single brand; regional divisions East, Gulf Coast, West)
brands.share: Aggregates 74.6% of segment sales and 90.4% of gross profit FY2025
